title: Could You Spend the Richest Person's Fortune?
description:
Could you spend the world's richest person's money if you spent a million dollars every day?

Sources:
- Forbes 400 (September 2026): Elon Musk about $908 billion, top of Forbes' real-time billionaires list (CNN, syndicated): https://www.wafb.com/2026/09/19/elon-musk-jeff-bezos-among-richest-americans-forbes-2026-list-heres-how-much-theyre-worth/

Net worth changes daily with stock prices; figure as reported September 19, 2026. 908,000 days divided by 365 = about 2,487 years. Not financial advice.

loop: So, still think you could spend it all? Ask yourself:

scenes.narration: Could you spend the richest person's fortune if you blew a million dollars every single day?
In September 2026, Forbes put Elon Musk's net worth at about 908 billion dollars.
Most of it isn't cash. It's his shares in companies like Tesla and SpaceX.
At a million dollars a day, you'd need about 2,500 years to spend it all.
And that's if the number stood still. When the stocks rise, the fortune grows faster than you could spend it.
